items.headline: Anatomy of a good prompt
items.hook: Most weak AI answers start with a weak question. Here is what a good one contains.
points: Swipe for each part and a worked example.
items.ask: Which of the five do you usually leave out?
items.summary: Five parts, each one short. Swipe for each part and a worked example.
checks: written and reviewed in this project
own writing: no claims about any product
includes the reminder not to paste customer or company data where data is involved

slides.title: Role: who the AI should act as
slides.body: For example: 'You are a careful editor.' It sets the tone and the level.

slides.title: Task: what you want done, in one sentence
slides.body: One clear verb: summarise, compare, draft, list, check.

slides.title: Context: what it needs to know
slides.body: Audience, purpose, background. Do not paste customer or company data into an AI tool.

slides.title: Format: how the answer should look
slides.body: A table, five bullets, under 100 words, plain English.

slides.title: Limits: what to avoid
slides.body: Say what to leave out, and ask it to write 'not stated' instead of guessing.

slides.title: A worked example
slides.code: You are a careful editor. Summarise the text below for a busy manager. Use five bullets, under 100 words, plain English. If something is not stated, write 'not stated'. Text: [paste text]

items.source_note: Written for AI Daily Brief. No claims about any product.
